evidence.oralText: Antigravity on the Pro plan is weirdly generous right now. ~20M tokens today on Orchestrator (Argon) ... still sitting at: 95% weekly Gemini quota left, 82% of my 5h limit, 78% weekly Argon.
evidence.conflictsToKeep: Oral ~20M today is roughly the Antigravity slice of the Day panel (15.3+3.7+1.1=20.1M), not the 82.8M all-providers total which is mostly OpenCode. Official UI has percentages and no tokens. Day tokens are a different window from the weekly 95% left bar. Cannot pair 20M (or 82.8M) with 5% weekly used. cache% is not quota%.
evidence.why: 官方弹窗只有剩余百分比；token 来自第三方日面板且含 OpenCode。禁止用 20M 去反推周池。
